title: Boss: the 3 a.m. page
summary: An Alertmanager webhook wakes you. From its payload, the failing trace, the logs and the deploy history, produce the first incident update and the mitigation, the way a calm on-call engineer would.

steps.title: The page
body: Your bot receives Alertmanager's webhook (the real JSON format, `version: "4"`), and has access to Jaeger, Loki and the deploy
log. Build the three pieces of the first response: what fired, what the telemetry says, what to roll back.

steps.title: Read the webhook
prompt: Write `List<string> Summarize(string json)` for an Alertmanager webhook payload: one line per alert in `alerts`, in order:
`"{STATUS} {alertname} service={service} since {HH:mm} runbook={runbook_url}"`
- `STATUS` is the alert's `status` upper-cased (`FIRING` / `RESOLVED`);
- `alertname` and `service` come from its `labels`, `runbook_url` from its `annotations` (`-` when missing);
- `since` is `startsAt` (an RFC 3339 time) in UTC, as `HH:mm`.
Use `System.Text.Json` (`JsonDocument`).
solution: a.TryGetProperty(section, out var s) && s.TryGetProperty(key, out var v) ? v.GetString() ?? "-" : "-";

steps.title: What the telemetry says
prompt: From Jaeger you have the failing trace's spans, `record Span(string Id, string? Parent, string Service, string Name, string Status, int? HttpStatus);`,
and from Loki its log lines, `record Log(string SpanId, string Level, string Body, string? Code);`.
Write `string Finding(List<Span> spans, List<Log> logs)`:
- the **root cause span**: the error span with no error descendant (first in list order if several);
- the **callee**: its child span in another service, if any;
- the **evidence**: the first `Error` (else `Warning`) log line written in the root cause span, its parent, or the callee;
as `"{Service} {Name} -> {HttpStatus} from {callee.Service}; log: {Body} [{Code}]"`. Leave out ` -> ...` without a status,
`from ...` without a callee, and ` [{Code}]` without a code; with no log write `log: none`.
solution: bool ErrorBelow(Span s) => spans.Where(c => c.Parent == s.Id).Any(c => c.Status == "error" || ErrorBelow(c));
var callee = spans.FirstOrDefault(c => c.Parent == cause.Id && c.Service != cause.Service);
var ids = new HashSet<string?> { cause.Id, cause.Parent, callee?.Id };
var log = mine.FirstOrDefault(l => l.Level == "Error") ?? mine.FirstOrDefault(l => l.Level == "Warning");
if (callee is not null) text += $" from {callee.Service}";
text += log is null ? "; log: none" : $"; log: {log.Body}" + (log.Code is null ? "" : $" [{log.Code}]");
template: new("86d8", "Error", "Reservation failed for sku 12: stock conflict in warehouse eu-2 (code INV-5821)", "INV-5821") };
Dojo.Eq("the recorded failure", "shop POST -> 409 from inventory; log: Reservation failed for sku 12: stock conflict in warehouse eu-2 (code INV-5821) [INV-5821]", Finding(dojoSpans, dojoLogs));
Dojo.Eq("only the callee's warning", "shop POST -> 409 from inventory; log: Stock conflict on sku 12", Finding(dojoSpans, dojoLogs.Take(1).ToList()));
Dojo.Eq("no logs", "shop POST -> 409 from inventory; log: none", Finding(dojoSpans, new List<Log>()));
record Span(string Id, string? Parent, string Service, string Name, string Status, int? HttpStatus);
record Log(string SpanId, string Level, string Body, string? Code);

steps.title: What to roll back
prompt: Deploys are `record Deploy(string Service, string Version, string Previous, DateTime At);`. Write
`string Mitigation(List<Deploy> deploys, string[] services, DateTime errorsSince)`:
- consider deploys of any of `services` (the ones in the failing trace) that happened **at most 30 minutes before** `errorsSince`
(and not after it);
- pick the **latest** of them and return `"roll back {Service} {Version} -> {Previous} (deployed {m} min before the errors)"`
(whole minutes, rounded down);
- with none, return `"no recent deploy of {services joined by , }: escalate to the owners"`.
starter: string Mitigation(List<Deploy> deploys, string[] services, DateTime errorsSince)
solution: string Mitigation(List<Deploy> deploys, string[] services, DateTime errorsSince)
var d = deploys.Where(x => services.Contains(x.Service) && x.At <= errorsSince && errorsSince - x.At <= TimeSpan.FromMinutes(30))
? $"no recent deploy of {string.Join(", ", services)}: escalate to the owners"
: $"roll back {d.Service} {d.Version} -> {d.Previous} (deployed {(int)(errorsSince - d.At).TotalMinutes} min before the errors)";
template: Dojo.Eq("the latest relevant deploy", "roll back inventory 2.8.0 -> 2.7.4 (deployed 1 min before the errors)", Mitigation(dojoDeploys, ["shop", "inventory"], dojoAt));
Dojo.Eq("only shop in the trace", "roll back shop 5.2.1 -> 5.2.0 (deployed 12 min before the errors)", Mitigation(dojoDeploys, ["shop"], dojoAt));
Dojo.Eq("nothing recent", "no recent deploy of payments: escalate to the owners", Mitigation(dojoDeploys, ["payments"], dojoAt));
record Deploy(string Service, string Version, string Previous, DateTime At);
